name: Highly Casual | 10mg Beverage | Cold Brew Coffee
description: Our Cold Brew Coffee is made for a smooth, rich taste—never bitter, always refreshing. Infused with 10mg of fast-acting THC, it's crafted for those who want more than just a caffeine buzz. Whether you're powering through creative work, kicking back on the weekend, or looking for a stronger cannabis experience in beverage form, this cold brew delivers a balanced lift with long-lasting energy. 10mg THC per can smooth, full-bodied cold brew flavor just coffee and cannabis perfect for experienced consumers sip, savor, and settle into your day-the highly casual way.
